text:
amanda: heads-up — new on-call shadow tonight :wave: @josh will be joining 18:00 PST / 02:00 UTC. plan is: quick runthrough of the most common playbooks, trigger a controlled page, then handoff notes. can we confirm primary/secondary and any coverage gaps? also want to test the incident-bot paging flow so josh can ack/respond.

josh: thanks! excited to shadow. i haven't done the redis shard failover runbook before, so would love to pair on that. i'm available for pairing 18:30 PST. :coffee:  

leo: I can be primary 18:00-00:00 PST tonight and run the failover walkthrough at 18:30. i'll walk through the quick checklist with you and simulate a safe failover. runbook link (read-only): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redis-shard-failover 

leo: quick runbook excerpt i'll show:
```
# redis shard failover - quick checklist
1) confirm shard health: /infra/metrics -> redis.shard-3.cpu, redis.shard-3.replica_lag
2) if leader is unresponsive, run: ./tools/redis-promote --shard=shard-3 --auto-confirm
3) verify clients reconnected: curl -s http://internal-proxy/health | jq .connections
4) notify: /incident create "redis shard failover" --impact=low --channel=#eng-oncall
```

amanda: perfect. we'll also trigger a test page at 19:00 PST (no customer impact) so josh can practice the ack/escalate flow. incident-bot will post the page and you should acknowledge within 2 mins. we'll record timings for the onboarding notes.

incident-bot: [automated] Scheduled test page: "eng-oncall test — onboarding shadow" will be sent to #eng-oncall at 19:00 PST. No customer impact.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled test page in ~40m (19:00 PST). Use `ack` to acknowledge.

maria: quick Q — looks like we have a coverage hole 22:00-02:00 UTC on the rota (no secondary listed). is someone able to pick that up? want to avoid leaving late-night window unpaired while josh is still shadowing.

ryan: I can take 22:00-02:00 UTC tonight as secondary. will set my calendar and standby. :+1:

leo: thanks @ryan — i've noted it. updated handoff plan below and will push to the oncall calendar.

leo: Handoff note (to paste into the rotation tool):
```
On-call Handoff (UTC):
- Primary: leo (18:00-00:00 PST / 02:00-08:00 UTC)
- Secondary: ryan (22:00-02:00 UTC)
- Shadow: josh (onboarding)
- Active incidents: none
- Watchlist: redis shard-3 replica lag elevated after last rollout; latency spike threshold set at 200ms
- Runbooks to practice: redis-shard-failover, api-rate-limit-mitigation
```

amanda: nice. @josh, when you ack the test page, follow the short-playbook: ack -> check /status -> post ETA in thread -> start mitigation if needed. i'll be watching and taking notes.

josh: got it. i'll follow the checklist. also will take notes and update the runbook where things were confusing.

leo: small ops tip for the test page: if you get paged and it's a false positive, mark it as `practice` in the incident metadata so we don't escalate to SRE rotations. example: `/incident create "practice: test page" --tags practice`

amanda: we'll record the ack times and add to the onboarding doc. after the walkthrough i'll send a short survey to josh to capture what felt unclear.

josh: looking forward to it. see you at 18:30. :wave:  

amanda: thanks everyone — i'll update the rotation and send the calendar invites. tagging the ops runbook maintainers for follow-up: @leo, @maria. :thumbsup:
